candidates.explanation: The `fetchAndUpdate` method accesses the `EcosiaEnvironment.current` singleton to retrieve the statistics URL, creating a hard-coded dependency on a global singleton service.
candidates.title: Direct Singleton Service Access

evidence.description: Mutable properties declared with internal(set) without isolation
Async function updating these properties from multiple concurrency contexts

candidates.explanation: The `Statistics` class contains multiple mutable properties (e.g., `treesPlanted`, `activeUsers`) that are updated within an `async` function (`fetchAndUpdate`) without any actor isolation or synchronization mechanisms, creating a risk of data races.
candidates.title: Improper Isolation of Shared Mutable State
